Erail Track

Erail track is a medium-duty compact profile, extruded aluminium track. Suitable for walk-along, manual corded and motorised operation. With a range of fixings, it is very flexible and suitable for numerous applications in a wide range of venues, only excluding the heaviest professional main stage curtains.

 

It can be bent to a minimum radius of 500mm, and it is supplied in silver or a black finish. Almost silent in operation, Erail is an ideal choice for small stages, conference halls, hotels and school halls. It has the option of being motorised using an SDrive or a TDrive motor.
